## Highlights
### New
- Open multiple windows with shared Spaces and tabs, keeping your place in each window - Open disposable blank windows with your Space’s cookies and extensions, or create one by dragging a tab outside the window
### Improved
- Open blank windows with Command-Option-N and Quick Windows with Command-Option-Shift-N - Position torn-off windows where you drop the tab, keeping the window within the display
### Fixed
- Keep dragged tabs visible outside the window and give blank windows the normal browser appearance - Keep pages loaded when you switch to them in another window during memory cleanup - Keep extension and built-in pages on their own device so they cannot block iCloud sync
---
